title: Professional Certificate Course in Overview of Financial Statements
description: It covers the role of financial statements and their constituents, including consolidated financial statements and their users.
longDescription: Understand the nature of Financial Statements. Identify the Users and role of Financial Statements and the Relationship between Constituents of Financial Statements. Understand the nature of Consolidated Financial Statements and how they differ from financial statements. Understand the Structure of Financial Statements and their analytical framework. The aim of the course "Overview of Financial Statements" is to equip learners with a fundamental understanding of financial statements, their structure, and the methods used to analyze them. modules.title: Overview Of Financial Statements
modules.summary: The course "Overview of Financial Statements" provides an introduction to the nature, structure, and analysis framework of financial statements. It covers the role of financial statements and their constituents, including consolidated financial statements, and their users. The course also explores the methods of analyzing financial statements, such as horizontal analysis, vertical analysis, ratio analysis, and trend analysis.
